lines.t: We lift our eyes beyond the burning sky
Past shaking stars and falling light
Kingdom of YahuShua‑YahuWaH, draw near
Make this broken cosmos bright
Slow tides of glory roll through the night
Soft pads shimmer with Your light
Planets tremble, but our hearts stay still
Hidden in the center of Your willGalaxies swirl in a holy dance
Every orbit moves by more than chance
From the dust of ruins, You raise a song
Gentle bass breathing, pulling us along
Here in the quiet between the quakes
Your whisper is the ground that never breaks
House‑beat heartbeat under star‑filled air
We float in Your Presence everywhere
YAHUSHUA, CENTER OF IT ALL
From the smallest spark to the cosmic wall
YAHUWAH, LOVER OF THE WEAK
In the war of worlds, it’s Your peace we seekKingdom rivers through the Milky Way
Chillstep oceans where we kneel and pray
Every drop of light, every distant sun
Echoes of the Lamb who has overcome
Soft kick, side‑chained to Your breath
Grace in the space between life and death
144,000 hearts in time
But the lead line’s You, Holy and sublimeNo stained glass here, only open skies
Church without walls in Your endless heights
From Dallas streets to Orion’s rim
One lowly Bride, eyes locked on Him
We don’t fear the shaking of the spheres
You’ve numbered all our days and tears
In the great still sea of crystal glass
Your mercy waves are all that last
YAHUSHUA, CENTER OF IT ALL
From the smallest spark to the cosmic wall
YAHUWAH, LOVER OF THE WEAK
In the war of worlds, it’s Your peace we seekKingdom rivers through the Milky Way
Chillstep oceans where we kneel and pray
Every drop of light, every distant sun
Echoes of the Lamb who has overcome
Holy, Holy, through the endless blue
Galactic Sanctuary, all in You
